title: Restricted Boolean function
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a Boolean function on the $r$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in that cube. The resulting Boolean function on a cube with $|J|$ coordinates is obtained by evaluating $g$ with every coordinate in $J$ fixed to $+1$, and with the remaining coordinates supplied by the input, reindexed by their positions in $J$.
